policy: Third-party assets are PRIVATE and LOCAL ONLY. Never commit asset binaries. This file records candidate sources, terms and import settings only. Hashes are filled into the gitignored LocalAssets/resolved-manifest.json on the user's PC.
socketConvention: Ship meshes carry UE sockets named WPN_<Type>_<Loc>_<NN> (Beam, Pulse, Disruptor, Spiral, Plasma_Whip, Torp, Plasma_Torp, Cutting_Beam), FX_Engine_NN, FX_Cloak, FX_Shield_Center. Blender empties prefixed SOCKET_ are exported as UE sockets. Weapon entries bind by socketPrefix.
